diagrams.title: How the pieces connect
diagrams.note: Built, merged and released as 0.9.0 (all tests pass; nothing has run on a real Windows machine): the shared rules package (core_domain) and the counter app with its encrypted local database (SQLCipher, key in the Windows credential store, recovery key shown once): sign-in, stock entry and hangtags, billing register with pay later, markdowns and hold bill, returns and credit notes, shifts with the blind cash close, the daybook, the owner's daily report, analytics, staff, categories, GST (off by default, rules unverified), and backups to a USB drive and a folder with restore. The Windows installer builds in CI. Not built: GST reports, sync, cloud, mobile app. Dashed lines are release 2.

diagrams.title: What happens in one sale
diagrams.note: Built: scanning, cashier-safe lookup, pricing with markdowns set ahead of time, the discount limit with manager approval, payment and change, pay later (a manager allows it; the unpaid part is kept per bill), GST when the owner switches it on, credit notes, the bill number, an open shift, and the one local transaction that marks garments SOLD and writes the bill, daybook rows, audit and outbox. The daybook feeds the shift close and the owner's daily report. Not built: receipts other than A4, GST reports.
